piece_A.rule: sibling stands of a MARS family (a code ending in a digit X, and X+L / X+R present in the data, in either direction; tunnel 5's c5_mars.py); for a departure the accepted rule does not move, the last sibling arrival whose in-block precedes the predicted off-block (take-off - prediction after the accepted layer), of a different aircraft type than the departure, with 0 < gap <= 3,600 s; we left before it: label > B = take-off - its in-block
piece_A.airports: those with >= 10 candidate rows and >= 90% of them satisfying label >= B - 60 s in the fitting months (twelve-month table, after the accepted layer), intersected with the accepted layer's airport set of the fitting months
piece_A.value: max(prediction, B + the accepted intruder model's offset for the airport and gap band, fitted on the fitting months); floor -12 s; nearest integer in an export

rule.text: accepted when (1) no development month is worse than the control by more than 0.005% of its RMSE; (2) the equal-footing mean (January, July, December 2025) is at most -0.02%; (3) every equal-footing month's paired-day 95% interval lies below zero; (4) in the twelve-month check no month is worse than its control by more than 0.005% and at least two thirds of the months are better
rule.intervals: paired-day bootstrap over UTC take-off days, 2,000 replicates, seed 20261003
